name: Florida Southeast Connection Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not in the US gas roster under any name (no row for Florida Southeast Connection; distinct from Sabal Trail P0249, P2605, P2606, which end at the Central Florida Hub in Osceola County where this line starts). Built by NextEra Energy subsidiary Florida Southeast Connection, LLC under FERC docket CP14-554, as one of three Southeast Market Pipelines projects (Federal Register draft environmental impact statement notice of September 2015). A 2013 FPL release and a January 2015 RBN Energy article both give about 126 miles and about $550 million. RBN and Transmission and Distribution World give the route as Osceola County hub to Martin County. All three sources are pre-construction. In-service in 2017 (RBN planned May 2017) comes from the discovery note and was not confirmed by a post-completion source, so status operating is inferred and the start year is medium confidence. Capacity not staged: RBN says 400 MMcf/d planned, the commonly quoted 640,000 Dth/d was not verified in a non-GEM source. Diameter (30 and 36 in reported) not verified. Owner entity: NextEra Energy Inc is the ownership-team spelling on an alias hit; the project company Florida Southeast Connection, LLC has no existing entity. Adds 126 mi of new pipe, above the 15.5 mi threshold. Route not researched; RouteType unavailable until a FERC GIS shapefile is sourced. Next step: find an in-service notice (FERC letter June 2017) and the FERC GIS route.
